description: Synthetic evaluation set for Holdwise message extraction. 'seed' messages are the demo inbox (the rules parser was tuned on them); 'held_out' messages were written separately and never used to tune the rules. Expected items use catalogue SKUs; sku null means the right outcome is a flag for a human (expect_flag). qty null means the customer gave no quantity.
